raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Move the non-Kernels AMD CI test groups with the highest NFS-associated runtime impact from MI300 to MI355.

| Group | Affected runs | Normal -> affected runtime | Median ratio | Max affected runtime |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| LM Eval Large Models Harness | 21/42 | 23.1 -> 34.4 min | 1.49x | 86.2 min (3.73x) |
| Spec Decode DeepSeek MTP Parallel Load | 11/19 | 14.1 -> 20.2 min | 1.43x | 29.7 min (2.10x) |
| Distributed Torchrun + Examples | 13/70 | 12.9 -> 18.2 min | 1.41x | 56.4 min (4.39x) |
| LM Eval Large Models FP8 | 9/40 | 18.8 -> 28.1 min | 1.50x | 40.7 min (2.16x) |
| DeepSeek V2-Lite Sync EPLB Accuracy | 12/42 | 5.1 -> 13.1 min | 2.58x | 21.1 min (4.14x) |
| Distributed DP + EP | 13/39 | 8.6 -> 15.1 min | 1.75x | 19.9 min (2.31x) |
| Rust Frontend Distributed | 13/41 | 10.7 -> 15.6 min | 1.46x | 20.5 min (1.92x) |
| Qwen3-Next-80B MTP Async EPLB Accuracy | 7/41 | 12.5 -> 19.8 min | 1.59x | 22.9 min (1.84x) |
| LM Eval Small Models Distributed | 6/41 | 30.0 -> 39.7 min | 1.32x | 41.3 min (1.38x) |
| Entrypoints Integration (Speech to Text) | 4/43 | 31.1 -> 41.7 min | 1.34x | 61.2 min (1.97x) |

## Rationale

The analysis covered 1,524 amd-ci builds since Sep 25 and 14,541 job logs from Oct 10-20. 

For each group and checkpoint-size bucket, the median model-loading time defines the normal load baseline. A run is affected when a same-size load takes more than 2x baseline and adds more than 120 seconds. Normal runtime is the median of successful jobs without an affected load, while affected runtime is the median job runtime among affected runs. Groups were ranked by the total runtime above normal accumulated by affected runs, divided by all observed runs, with at least 15 runs required to avoid low-sample outliers.

AI-assisted tooling was used to analyze the historical CI job metadata and logs; the results and proposed changes were manually reviewed.

Update:
Four additional test groups were added to the MI355 migration:
| Group | Affected runs | Normal -> affected runtime | Median ratio | Max affected runtime |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Acceptance Length (Large Models) | 7/43 | 6.1 -> 12.8 min | 2.09x | 16.3 min (2.67x) |
| LM Eval KV-Offload Medium | 9/43 | 12.9 -> 16.4 min | 1.27x | 24.3 min (1.88x) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-block Sync EPLB Accuracy | 7/42 | 4.8 -> 8.8 min | 1.82x | 11.5 min (2.37x) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 DP4 Async EPLB Accuracy | 5/42 | 5.0 -> 8.0 min | 1.58x | 9.7 min (1.93x) |

- `/ci run` starts upstream CI; `/amd-ci run` starts AMD CI only.
- Run commands test your branch with every commit currently on its upstream target branch. If it is behind, the bot merges the target branch into it first (pull before pushing again). Append `--allow-stale` to a run command to test an outdated branch as is, at your own risk.
- `/ci retry` retries failed jobs in the CI build for the current PR head. If the current head has no CI build, it starts a new CI build for the current head containing only jobs that failed in the latest earlier CI build for this PR.
- `/amd-ci retry` retries failed jobs in AMD CI for the current PR head. Use `/amd-ci run` when the current head has no AMD CI build.
- `/ci cancel` cancels scheduled or running CI builds for this PR branch; `/amd-ci cancel` does the same for AMD CI only.
